simple.meaning: קֶבֶר (qeber) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a sepulchre.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 23:4. The surrounding context includes family, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֶבֶר (H6913) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: קֶבֶר (qeber) / H6913 is traced through Genesis 23:4, Genesis 23:6, Genesis 23:9, Genesis 23:20 with generated occurrence evidence.
